content.text:
The two pieces of evidence conflict. Tenant 3 gives Ridge Road as shortest at 29 minutes. Tenant 4 says the Lakeshore route is shortest at 24 minutes, because the reopened bridge changed its time.

The rule says travel time is the sum of the leg times, but neither source gives leg times, only totals. Tenant 4's note appears to be an update, since the bridge "reopened," so Lakeshore's total dropped from 32 to 24. Under that update, Lakeshore at 24 is below Ridge Road at 29, which makes Lakeshore the shortest.

The two logs come from different tenants, so it is not clear that one supersedes the other. Still, Tenant 4's claim is specific and explains why the time changed, while Tenant 3's totals do not account for the bridge reopening. Going with the more recent information, Lakeshore is the best answer.

**B**
